blazers.pulse: Fans are still sore about Tuesday's 106-105 collapse in Minnesota, the second loss in two nights to the Wolves. Tonight's trip to Milwaukee looks like the perfect bounce-back spot: the Bucks are 1-14 and have lost 11 straight, but Avdija's foot is the big question.
storylines: Last game: lost 106-105 at Minnesota on a McDaniels layup with 2.6 seconds left after a stolen inbounds pass
Tonight at Milwaukee, 5 p.m. Pacific; Portland 9-5, Bucks 1-14
Deni Avdija (sore foot) and Toumani Camara (abdominal soreness) are questionable
Avdija is averaging 24.2 points, 6.2 rebounds and 6.1 assists
Bettors have Portland as roughly a 10-point favorite

timbers.pulse: No game since the regular-season finale, so it's all playoff build-up. Portland heads to Frisco as the West's No. 7 seed on a four-game win streak to face No. 2 FC Dallas, a 58-point team that has never beaten the Timbers in four playoff meetings.
storylines: Game 1 at FC Dallas: Sat Nov 21, 1 p.m. Pacific, on Apple TV
Game 2 at Providence Park: Sat Nov 28, 7:30 p.m. Pacific, Apple TV and FS1; Game 3 in Dallas Dec 2 if needed
Ties after 90 minutes go straight to penalties, no extra time
Velde carries the attack with 12 goals and 10 assists
Cifuentes says Antony has a chance to return from a knee issue (Rotowire, Nov 16)

f1.pulse: Cars hit the Strip tonight for practice. Antonelli and Mercedes already have both titles, so the buzz is the scrap for second, where two-time Vegas winner Verstappen is the in-form driver, and whether the cold desert night scrambles the order.
storylines: Practice Thursday night, race Saturday Nov 21; three races left
P2 fight: Verstappen 279, Russell 262, Hamilton 261, Leclerc 249, Norris 246
Pirelli warns cold track temps, tyre warm-up and graining could decide the race
Hamilton says the constructors' fight is Ferrari's main focus
Cadillac seat question: stick with Bottas or give Colton Herta his shot

ducks.pulse: Duck fans are still riding the 31-7 rout of Michigan, and Michigan State's quarterback mess makes Friday look very winnable. The nagging worry is Oregon's own injury list and the fact that the Ducks have never won in East Lansing.
storylines: Next game: Friday Nov 20 at Michigan State, 5:00 p.m. Pacific on FOX
Spartans QB Alessio Milivojevic is out and backup Cam Fancher is questionable with a knee injury
Oregon has eight players out on the first report, including OLB Teitum Tuioti; Jerry Mixon questionable, Bear Alexander probable
Dante Moore still hasn't played since the Sept. 26 hit against USC
Oregon is 0-3 all-time in East Lansing; finale vs. Washington Nov 28

niners.pulse: The 8-1 Niners are still buzzing from the shootout win in Dallas, and most experts pick them in Mexico City. The nerves come from Shanahan's 0-5 record against Vikings DC Brian Flores and a new Mike Evans injury scare.
storylines: Next game: Sunday Nov 22 vs. Vikings in Mexico City, 5:20 p.m. Pacific on NBC/Peacock
Mike Evans missed Wednesday practice with an Achilles issue; Shanahan hopes he's back Thursday
Shanahan is 0-5 against Brian Flores defenses
Most of SI's MMQB staff pick the 49ers, but two took Minnesota
Team is practicing in Colorado Springs to get used to the altitude

sources.name: NBC Sports Bay Area (how to watch)
